s: [s] klI, (Ap + asun nuw hrasvaSca .) jalaM । vedaprayogo'yaM ॥
a: अप्नः, अप्नस् — n. [आप् --असुन् नुट् थस्वश्च, Uṇ. 4. 207] 1 Possession, property. --2 Work, sacrificial act or rite, any act. --3 Offspring. --4 Form, shape. --5 To be obtained (used actively); [cf. L. ops.] --Comp. --स्थ a. superintending work (कर्मण्यधिकृत); (or m.) proprietor of an estate. --राजः lord of wealth or property, illustrious by means of works; directing works to be done (कर्मप्रेरक).

v: tri॰ apnasi karmaRi tizWati aDikftatvAt sTA--ka 7 ta॰ । 1 karmaRyaDikfte “saMyAvapnaHsTo apaseva” f॰ 6, 67, 3 । “apnaHsTaH karmaRyaDikftaH” BA॰ ।

m: अप्न-राज् mfn. (अप्न = अप्नस् below), presiding over property, RV. x, 132, 7.

v: pu॰ apnasAM karmmaRAM rAjA prerakatvAt wac samA॰ vede pf॰ salopaH । karmmaprerake । “yuvaM hyamarAjAvasIdatam f॰ 101327 ।

tri॰ Apa--asun nuw hrasvaSca । 1 karmmaRi miru॰ । “kriyAto viBAgaH viBAgAt pUrvvadeSasaMyoganASastata ucaradeSasaMyoga” ityukteH saMyogahetutvAttaTAtvam “taddevezu cakfze BadramapnaH f॰ 1, 113, 9 । “apnaH karma” BA॰ । vA॰ akarmmAKyAyAmapi asun nuw hrasvaSca । 2 prAptavye, “yaccitramapna uzaso vahanta” f॰ 1, 113, 20 । “apraH prAptavyam” BA॰ ।
tri॰ apnas + astyarTe matup masya vaH striyAM NIp । karmayukte । “apnasvatIzurvvarAsviti” f॰ 1, 127, 6 । “apnasvatIzu KananAdikarmmopretAsu” BA॰ ।
m: अप्नस्—वत् (अप्नस्-), mfn. giving property, profitable, RV.
a: अप्नस्वत् — a. Having(sacrificial) acts or works; productive.

v: pu॰ apnasA karmmaRA vAnaM gatiH sadgatirasya । BfguvaMSye, fziBede, “yamapnavAno Bfgavo virurucuH f॰ 4, 7, 1, apnavAnaH BfgusambanDI kaScidfziH, BA॰ । “OrvyaBfguvadapnavAnavadAhuve agniM samudrasam” f॰ 8, 102, 4, asyEva vatsAdigotrapravaratvam “vatsAnAM BArgavacyavanApnavAnOrvyajAmadagnyAH” iti “BArgavOrvajAmadgnyAH” iti vA “BArgavacyavanApnuvAnAH” iti vA “vedAnAM paYca, BArgavacyavanApnavAnOrvavedAH” iti gotrapravarA॰ । vaNgAnAmApnuvataH pravaratvakalpanaM pravarADyAyavirudDatvAdDeyam । apnase AdAnakarmaRe vAnamasya pf॰ salopaH । bAhO niru॰ ।
m: अप्नवान m. N. of a Ṛṣi (appointed with the Bhṛgus), RV. iv, 7, 1
a: अप्नवान — a. 1 Having progeny. --2 Poor. --नः [अप्नसे आदायकर्मणे वानं यस्यपृषो ˚सलोपः Tv.] 1 The arm. --2 N. of a Ṛṣi in the family of or connected with Bhṛgu.

m: अप्नवान—वत् ind. like Apnavāna, RV. viii, 102, 4.
